workflow.title: Local cloud copies or ordinary files? Plan a Mac space review before eviction
workflow.primaryIntent: Distinguish synced local copies from other Mac storage before choosing cloud-file eviction or a different investigation.
outline: Conclusion: a cloud-copy tool is a different choice from deleting ordinary files or caches.
Show official Flint app visual immediately after lead once cleared; document treemap, sync-state labels, filters and batch selection without claiming hands-on tests.

Use a preflight checklist: identify provider, establish sync completion and cloud availability, identify offline-needed files, stop when status is uncertain. This is editorial guidance, not verified Flint safeguards.
Explain documented local-copy eviction versus unsupported guarantees; no irreversible cleanup instructions or execution.
Use the labeled Breathing Room Space preview to illustrate broader storage investigation, not a claim of cloud eviction support.
Bounded choice: Flint for its documented cloud-copy focus; Breathing Room, which we build, for broader preview-source storage/activity investigation; keep installation and hosted-AI caveats visible.
workflow.distinctness: Cloud-copy intent and sync-state uncertainty, not a generic cleaner ranking or expanded comparison matrix.
workflow.interactionPass: Decision checklist: cloud folder? sync state established? cloud copy independently available? offline access needed? uncertain answers mean stop, not permission to evict. No filesystem APIs, uploads or invented savings.
needsBeforeDrafting: Competitor screenshot reuse clearance and visual inspection.
Official provider/Apple procedural evidence if drafting provider-specific eviction steps; omit such steps until sourced.

flintAdvantages.text: Documented unified view of four cloud providers, sync states, treemap and batch local-copy eviction is a focused fit for cloud-heavy Mac storage.

flintTradeoffs.text: Free download does not establish unlimited free eviction; exact free limits and direct-build purchase conditions remain unknown.
macOS 14+ requirement is channel-specific; no verified wider monitoring/developer-cache parity or guaranteed data-loss protection.

breathingRoomAdvantages.text: Source-documented broader storage, process/helper and activity investigation can fit non-cloud Mac maintenance questions; this is not certified binary behavior.

breathingRoomTradeoffs.text: Non-notarized preview, Python inventory prerequisite, hosted authenticated AI, optional paid AI Care, and runtime QA gaps must remain explicit. No verified equivalent cloud-copy eviction capability.
